✨ Welcome to Dress My Room! ✨

Enter the game, choose a theme, and create the room of your dreams with the furniture and decoration of your choice!  Compete against other players and see who creates the most stylish room.

Be the FIRST to stay ahead of the latest décor trends : tap  Notify so you don’t miss a thing!

Earn & Expand: Win coins every round to unlock exclusive designer furniture, lighting, and premium decor in the Shop!

🎃 Halloween Update is here!

🖤  Black Nouveau VIP for even more glamour.

🗓️ Come back every day to claim your rewards from the Daily Calendar !
